snippet.title: My Arms Are Longer Now – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
My Arms Are Longer Now arrives March 11, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch!

Your arms are about to get a lot longer.

In this new look at My Arms Are Longer Now, the debut externally published title from Jackbox Games and developer Toot Games, check out fresh gameplay: stretching through vents, snatching wallets and watches, dragging off bikes and dogs, and slipping past guards.

Play as a very long arm on a mission to rob everyone blind, all while a hard-boiled detective narrates your crime spree and interviews your victims.

#IndieWorld #MyArmsAreLongerNow

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
